scientific.integrity: The derivation is exact: piecewise curvature Fourier coefficients, support coefficients, Minkowski phase averaging, Parseval area and an evaluated cosine series. Symbolic and direct-geometric checks independently corroborate the expression; numeric samples are not infinite proofs. The closest two primary sources were materially read and compared by implication.
limitations: Restricted to equal-weight means of one Euclidean Reuleaux triangle and its rotated copy.
The familiar triangle and disk endpoint areas and the support/Parseval method are established prior work.
An older unindexed angular mixed-area computation remains a historical originality risk.

title: Exact rotational Minkowski-average area profile of the Reuleaux triangle
